title: TE Academy update - Looking for program hosts

posts.cooked:
Hey TEC - Wanted to share a quick update from the TE Academy!

We are kicking off a new program to help folks dive one level deeper into the TE field - Token Engineering 360 - and are looking for community members to contribute and help make it happen!

After the successful collaboration with the TEC on our “Introduction to Token Engineering” sessions, we thought this program would be another great chance to collaborate.

We are looking for 1-2 people interested in

  • learning Token Engineering
  • further developing this program
  • taking over operational tasks

and available around 2 hours per week.

Token Engineering 360 will be a 6-session discussion series that provides a 360 degree overview of Token Engineering and crypto-economic systems. You can find more program details here TokenEngineering Academy | Token Engineering. It’s also part of our efforts to engage with future students of TE Fundamentals (we’ve collected > 500 sign ups so far!), and onboard them into this community.

If you are interested, send me a message on discord (@heater#9765) for more detail!

Thank you so much for sharing this!
